title: Research paper review finding
description: One finding from a review seat of the research-paper plugin. Reports are ARRAYS of these objects. Adapted from claude-code-my-workflow .claude/references/finding-schema.json (MIT, Pedro H. C. Sant'Anna, commit ae72617). Validate with validate_findings.py.

id.description: sha1('file:line:locus'), filled by validate_findings.py --fill-ids; lens is not part of it, so two seats finding the same defect at the same place get the same id.

locus.description: section, table, figure, stage or component; 'absence:<where>' for a missing item

rule.description: CFP criterion or aspect, or the named rule or norm; '[FIELD-NORM UNVERIFIED]' prefix when the norm has no checkable source

evidence.description: exact quoted spans of 12+ characters with line numbers; for absence: the sections searched

not_established.description: one sentence naming what this finding does not show

audit_status.description: forensic audit findings only (from nature-skills forensic-consistency-audit.md)

verdict.description: set by the adjudicator; held = an owner decision, recorded and not acted on

adjudication.description: set by the adjudicator: the source text or check behind the verdict

tier.description: set by the adjudicator for confirmed and downgraded findings

merged_ids.description: set by the adjudicator: ids of duplicates merged into this finding
